claims.text: 4-month regimen: rifapentine + moxifloxacin + isoniazid + pyrazinamide for 2 months, then rifapentine + moxifloxacin + isoniazid for 2 months and 1 week.
claims.quote: The 4-month 2HPZM/2HPM regimen has an intensive phase of 2 months of isoniazid, rifapentine, pyrazinamide, and moxifloxacin, followed by a continuation phase of 2 months and 1 week of isoniazid, rifapentine, and moxifloxacin (a total of 17 weeks for treatment).

claims.text: For age 12 and older, at least 40 kg; with HIV only if CD4 ≥ 100
claims.quote: People who are 12 years and older, People with a body weight at or above 40 kg, People with HIV with CD4 counts at or above 100 cells/microliter
who are receiving or planning to start an antiretroviral therapy (ART) regimen that does not have known drug-drug interactions with the 2HPZM/2HPM regimen
